final: WITH p AS (SELECT oi.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pr.production_type_code GROUP BY oi.product_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM p), g AS (SELECT d, AVG(aq) AS a1, AVG(c) AS a2, AVG(c * 1.0 / (SELECT tot FROM t)) AS a3 FROM p GROUP BY d) SELECT AVG(a1) AS avg_quantity, AVG(a2) AS avg_item_count, AVG(a3) AS avg_share FROM g
